edges.description: Loss of WAC disrupts one of its established cellular functions in autophagy regulation
Congenital cardiac malformation reported with WAC loss of function; the developmental route from WAC dosage to the septal defect is not established.
Congenital outflow-tract valve malformation reported with WAC loss of function; the developmental route is not established.
WAC loss perturbs inhibitory neuronal development and brain circuitry
Perturbed inhibitory circuitry contributes to seizure and behavioral phenotypes
WAC-related neurodevelopmental dysfunction manifests as delayed developmental milestones.
The same neurodevelopmental circuit disruption contributes to intellectual disability.
Neurobehavioral abnormalities in WAC-related disease include autistic behavior.
GABAergic-neuron perturbation lowers seizure threshold in DeSanto-Shinawi syndrome.
Syndromic WAC haploinsufficiency includes a recognizable craniofacial gestalt.
The same inhibitory-circuit perturbation that lowers seizure threshold is recorded interictally as focal epileptiform discharges on EEG.
Neurobehavioral abnormalities in WAC-related disease include ADHD and behavioral difficulties alongside the autism phenotype.
